from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionMetric(BaseModel):
    """One institution's metrics for correlation analysis."""
    institution: str | None = Field(description="Name of the institution")
    student_faculty_ratio: float | None = Field(description="Student-to-faculty ratio from Section I-2")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort as percentage from Section B4")
    data_period: str | None = Field(description="Period when data was collected, YYYY-MM format")
    source_section_ratio: str | None = Field(description="CDS section where ratio is reported")
    source_section_graduation: str | None = Field(description="CDS section where graduation rate is reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institution_metrics: list[InstitutionMetric]
